description.zh: 更新代理运行时输入参数
description.en: The input parameters for updating the agent runtime.

descriptions.zh: 更新指定智能体运行时的配置信息，包括资源分配、网络配置、环境变量等。更新操作会触发运行时重启。
descriptions.en: Updates the configuration of a specified agent runtime, including resource allocation, network configuration, and environment variables. The update operation triggers a runtime restart.
